worldcombat.skill.metronome.summary: Waggles a finger to stimulate itself, then randomly performs one of the moves implemented in the world.
After wagging for %1$s it borrows and performs one random move from every implemented move.
The stirred move can reach %1$s; wagging again costs %2$s.
Current bias: %1$s. Near or far narrows the candidates in exchange for a draw that fits the distance.
The wag shows %1$s candidate sparks, growing with Special Attack.
worldcombat.skill.metronome.preference.b: Full spectrum keeps any move; near draws only from close-range moves; far draws only from long-range moves. A bias narrows the pool, and falls back to the full pool when nothing fits.
